patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: I was just sitting there and suddenly got this sharp pain in the right side of my chest and couldn't catch my breath. It's worse when I breathe in. I'm tall and thin, it came out of nowhere.
presentation.triageNote: 24-year-old tall, thin male with sudden sharp right-sided chest pain and shortness of breath while sitting at rest. Pain worsens on inspiration; breath sounds are reduced on the right and oxygen saturation is 92%.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 2 is appropriate because sudden pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, unilateral reduced breath sounds, and oxygen saturation 92% are high-risk for an acute pleural air leak.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This tall, thin young adult has sudden right-sided pleuritic pain, dyspnea, hypoxemia, and reduced right breath sounds.
clinical.acuityReason: He is not described as hypotensive or in extremis, but the presentation can progress to tension physiology and requires rapid assessment.
expectedResources: Pleural decompression or drainage when indicated
teachingPoints: Hypotension, severe distress, distended neck veins, or rapid deterioration would indicate tension physiology and treatment should precede imaging.
Primary spontaneous events are common in tall thin young adults but secondary causes should be considered.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Rapid confirmation would guide oxygen and observation for a small stable event or pleural drainage for a larger or symptomatic one.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated upright, one hand on the right chest, breathing shallow
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 24-year-old tall, thin man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting upright, one hand pressed to the right side of his chest, breathing shallowly. Expression: alarmed and breathless. Clearly visible: a hand on the right chest and guarded, shallow breathing. No text, no logos.
